const daysBack = 90;
const windowStart = "CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '89 days'";
const windowEnd = "CURRENT_DATE";
const workflowName = 'LT - Report Daily Rollups';
const sourceSystem = 'rollups';

const sql = `
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_report_contacts;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_report_opps;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_report_forms;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_report_dates;

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_report_contacts AS
SELECT
  DATE(COALESCE(
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz,
    NULLIF(payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz,
    NULLIF(payload_json->>'dateAdded', '')::timestamptz,
    NOW()
  )) AS report_date,
  source_key AS ghl_contact_id,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_source_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_source_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Source First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Source Last', ''), 'unknown') AS source,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_medium_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_medium_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Medium First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Medium Last', ''), 'unknown') AS medium,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_campaign_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_campaign_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Campaign First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Campaign Last', ''), 'unknown') AS campaign,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_content_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_content_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Content First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Content Last', ''), 'unknown') AS content,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_term_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_term_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Term First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Term Last', ''), 'unknown') AS term,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_landing_page_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_landing_page_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Landing Page First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Landing Page Last', ''), 'unknown') AS landing_page,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.lt_last_routing_channel', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.warm_source', ''), CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_source_first', dimensions_json->>'UTM Source First', '')) IN ('google', 'bing', 'yahoo') THEN 'organic search' ELSE 'unattributed' END, 'unattributed') AS channel,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.lt_last_routing_reason', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.warm_trigger_type', ''), 'ghl_source') AS routing_reason,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(payload_json->>'email', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'Email', '')) AS email,
  payload_json
FROM report_raw_ghl_contacts
WHERE DATE(COALESCE(
  NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz,
  NULLIF(payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz,
  NULLIF(payload_json->>'dateAdded', '')::timestamptz,
  NOW()
)) BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_report_opps AS
SELECT
  DATE(COALESCE(
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz,
    NULLIF(payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz,
    NULLIF(payload_json->>'lastStatusChangeAt', '')::timestamptz,
    NOW()
  )) AS report_date,
  source_key AS ghl_opportunity_id,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact_id', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.id', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'contactId', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'contact_id', '')) AS ghl_contact_id,
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'pipeline_name', ''),
    NULLIF(payload_json->>'pipelineName', ''),
    CASE COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'pipeline_id', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'pipelineId', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->'pipeline'->>'id', ''))
      WHEN 'FRjpDZ1HWj3UPgczsu3t' THEN 'Warm'
      WHEN 'dhdlf3O4tymxFtHk4aqq' THEN 'Sales Outreach'
      WHEN 'MThKauqlvnEFuFmAkyWX' THEN 'Sales'
      ELSE NULL
    END,
    'unknown'
  ) AS pipeline,
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'pipeline_stage_name', ''),
    NULLIF(payload_json->>'pipelineStageName', ''),
    NULLIF(payload_json->>'stage', ''),
    CASE COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'pipeline_stage_id', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'pipelineStageId', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->'pipelineStage'->>'id', ''))
      WHEN 'b961de1f-34fd-4b66-b032-f21225654868' THEN 'New'
      WHEN '3b3bd98d-cbb9-4c50-8cf3-b4eba29061c2' THEN 'Qualified (MQL)'
      WHEN '477c0b59-4a64-4566-81d6-63e233362520' THEN 'Routed to Outreach'
      WHEN '98775f02-0018-4629-9e69-0b1fcab293eb' THEN 'Nurture Active'
      WHEN 'dae2ddc5-a031-4ffa-bcdb-79d5c9afe91b' THEN 'Disqualified'
      WHEN '3529dd3d-cab0-4279-967c-1aea203de4fb' THEN 'New'
      WHEN 'b97e42b1-b4c2-4759-8212-33596a085cf2' THEN 'Attempting Contact 1st Attempt'
      WHEN 'c46c3be3-a216-4489-8ae3-c4284cfc747f' THEN '2nd attempt'
      WHEN 'c8b7a450-462a-497d-ab86-65f9a8e9b082' THEN '3rd attempt'
      WHEN '9ced8010-dfd7-4d5b-aa9c-c2eb58fca94d' THEN 'Engaged'
      WHEN '1ab47457-c945-4d16-9dd7-305583823114' THEN 'Meeting Requested'
      WHEN '1f95dd0a-1cf2-4d31-abad-825d97d3ef69' THEN 'Booked'
      WHEN '23276991-fbb3-4b0f-8d65-35c737b62bdd' THEN 'Unresponsive'
      WHEN '6f5aa304-a190-40da-8556-7c65bbc52733' THEN 'Discovery Scheduled'
      WHEN 'facd3d31-c634-40c5-9271-17d608b4379c' THEN 'Discovery Completed'
      WHEN '42b12e59-9b51-4c82-b597-4a9c972322c9' THEN 'Proposal Sent'
      WHEN 'f9022c83-7791-45c9-903d-381668454b2f' THEN 'Negotiation'
      WHEN 'f6b65baa-eac8-4f02-b91e-2ab0c8841b2d' THEN 'Closed Won'
      WHEN 'd7784617-96f4-4ae4-8b3e-e2088b62627d' THEN 'Closed Lost'
      ELSE NULL
    END,
    'unknown'
  ) AS stage,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'status', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'status', ''), 'open') AS status,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(metrics_json->>'monetary_value', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'monetaryValue', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'amount', ''), '0')::numeric AS monetary_value,
  payload_json
FROM report_raw_ghl_opportunities
WHERE DATE(COALESCE(
  NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz,
  NULLIF(payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz,
  NULLIF(payload_json->>'lastStatusChangeAt', '')::timestamptz,
  NOW()
)) BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_report_forms AS
SELECT
  DATE(COALESCE(
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz,
    NULLIF(payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz,
    NOW()
  )) AS report_date,
  source_key AS form_key,
  payload_json
FROM report_raw_ghl_forms
WHERE DATE(COALESCE(
  NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz,
  NULLIF(payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz,
  NOW()
)) BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_bridge_traffic AS
SELECT DISTINCT ON (report_date, ghl_contact_id)
  report_date,
  ghl_contact_id,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''),
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(traffic_source, '')) IN ('google', 'bing', 'yahoo') AND LOWER(COALESCE(medium, '')) IN ('organic', '(not set)', 'unknown', '') THEN 'organic search'
      WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(medium, '')) LIKE '%email%' THEN 'email'
      WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(medium, '')) LIKE '%sms%' THEN 'sms'
      ELSE 'unattributed'
    END
  ) AS channel,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(traffic_source, ''), 'unknown') AS source,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(medium, ''), 'unknown') AS medium,
  updated_at
FROM report_bridge_traffic_to_lead
WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd}
  AND COALESCE(ghl_contact_id, '') <> ''
ORDER BY report_date, ghl_contact_id, updated_at DESC;

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_report_dates AS
SELECT DISTINCT report_date FROM tmp_report_contacts
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT report_date FROM tmp_report_opps
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT report_date FROM tmp_report_forms;

DELETE FROM report_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};
INSERT INTO report_daily_summary (
  report_date, sessions, users, new_users, engaged_sessions, engagement_rate, gsc_clicks, gsc_impressions, gsc_ctr, gsc_position, contacts_created, form_submissions, opportunities_created, meetings_booked, closed_won_count, closed_won_revenue, closed_lost_count, metadata, updated_at
)
SELECT
  d.report_date,
  0,
  0,
  0,
  0,
  0,
  0,
  0,
  0,
  0,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_contacts c WHERE c.report_date = d.report_date), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_forms f WHERE f.report_date = d.report_date), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_opps o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_opps o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date AND (LOWER(stage) LIKE '%booked%' OR LOWER(stage) LIKE '%discovery scheduled%' OR LOWER(stage) LIKE '%meeting scheduled%')), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_opps o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date AND LOWER(status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won')), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(monetary_value) FROM tmp_report_opps o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date AND LOWER(status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won')), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_opps o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date AND LOWER(status) IN ('lost', 'closed_lost', 'closed lost')), 0),
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'rollups', 'workflow_name', '${workflowName}', 'mode', 'ghl_backfill_90d')::jsonb,
  NOW()
FROM tmp_report_dates d;

DELETE FROM report_channel_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};
INSERT INTO report_channel_daily_summary (
  report_date, channel, traffic_source, source, medium, sessions, users, new_users, leads, opportunities, closed_won_revenue, metadata, updated_at
)
WITH lead_facts AS (
  SELECT
    c.report_date,
    COALESCE(bt.channel, c.channel, 'unattributed') AS channel,
    COALESCE(bt.source, c.source, 'unknown') AS source,
    COALESCE(bt.medium, c.medium, 'unknown') AS medium,
    c.ghl_contact_id
  FROM tmp_report_contacts c
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT b.channel, b.source, b.medium
    FROM tmp_bridge_traffic b
    WHERE b.ghl_contact_id = c.ghl_contact_id
      AND b.report_date <= c.report_date
    ORDER BY b.report_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) bt ON TRUE
),
opp_facts AS (
  SELECT
    o.report_date,
    COALESCE(bt.channel, c.channel, 'unattributed') AS channel,
    COALESCE(bt.source, c.source, 'unknown') AS source,
    COALESCE(bt.medium, c.medium, 'unknown') AS medium,
    o.ghl_opportunity_id,
    o.status,
    o.monetary_value
  FROM tmp_report_opps o
  LEFT JOIN tmp_report_contacts c ON c.ghl_contact_id = o.ghl_contact_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT b.channel, b.source, b.medium
    FROM tmp_bridge_traffic b
    WHERE b.ghl_contact_id = o.ghl_contact_id
      AND b.report_date <= o.report_date
    ORDER BY b.report_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) bt ON TRUE
),
combined AS (
  SELECT report_date, channel, source, medium, COUNT(DISTINCT ghl_contact_id) AS leads, 0::bigint AS opportunities, 0::numeric AS closed_won_revenue
  FROM lead_facts
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
  UNION ALL
  SELECT report_date, channel, source, medium, 0::bigint AS leads, COUNT(DISTINCT ghl_opportunity_id) AS opportunities,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won') THEN monetary_value ELSE 0 END), 0)::numeric AS closed_won_revenue
  FROM opp_facts
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
)
SELECT
  d.report_date,
  c.channel,
  c.source,
  c.source,
  c.medium,
  0,
  0,
  0,
  SUM(c.leads)::bigint AS leads,
  SUM(c.opportunities)::bigint AS opportunities,
  SUM(c.closed_won_revenue)::numeric AS closed_won_revenue,
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'rollups', 'workflow_name', '${workflowName}', 'mode', 'ghl_backfill_90d')::jsonb,
  NOW()
FROM tmp_report_dates d
JOIN combined c ON c.report_date = d.report_date
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5;

DELETE FROM report_funnel_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};
INSERT INTO report_funnel_daily_summary (
  report_date, traffic, leads, sales, contact_to_opportunity_rate, opportunity_to_win_rate, metadata, updated_at
)
SELECT
  d.report_date,
  0,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_contacts c WHERE c.report_date = d.report_date), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_opps o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date AND LOWER(status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won')), 0),
  CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_contacts c WHERE c.report_date = d.report_date), 0) > 0
    THEN ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_opps o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date), 0)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_contacts c WHERE c.report_date = d.report_date), 0), 4)
    ELSE 0
  END,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_opps o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date), 0) > 0
    THEN ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_opps o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date AND LOWER(status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won')), 0)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_opps o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date), 0), 4)
    ELSE 0
  END,
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'rollups', 'workflow_name', '${workflowName}', 'mode', 'ghl_backfill_90d')::jsonb,
  NOW()
FROM tmp_report_dates d;

DELETE FROM report_pipeline_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};
INSERT INTO report_pipeline_daily_summary (
  report_date, pipeline, leads, opportunities, booked, closed_won_count, closed_won_revenue, closed_lost_count, metadata, updated_at
)
SELECT
  report_date,
  pipeline,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ghl_contact_id) AS leads,
  COUNT(*) AS opportunities,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(stage) LIKE '%booked%' OR LOWER(stage) LIKE '%discovery scheduled%' OR LOWER(stage) LIKE '%meeting scheduled%') AS booked,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won')) AS closed_won_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won') THEN monetary_value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closed_won_revenue,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(status) IN ('lost', 'closed_lost', 'closed lost')) AS closed_lost_count,
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'rollups', 'workflow_name', '${workflowName}', 'mode', 'ghl_backfill_90d')::jsonb,
  NOW()
FROM tmp_report_opps
GROUP BY 1, 2;

DELETE FROM report_stage_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};
INSERT INTO report_stage_daily_summary (
  report_date, pipeline, stage, stage_count, moved_in_count, moved_out_count, won_count, lost_count, metadata, updated_at
)
WITH stage_counts AS (
  SELECT
    report_date,
    pipeline,
    stage,
    COUNT(*)::int AS stage_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won'))::int AS won_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(status) IN ('lost', 'closed_lost', 'closed lost'))::int AS lost_count
  FROM tmp_report_opps
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
stage_with_prev AS (
  SELECT
    report_date,
    pipeline,
    stage,
    stage_count,
    LAG(stage_count) OVER (PARTITION BY pipeline, stage ORDER BY report_date) AS prev_stage_count,
    won_count,
    lost_count
  FROM stage_counts
)
SELECT
  report_date,
  pipeline,
  stage,
  stage_count,
  GREATEST(stage_count - COALESCE(prev_stage_count, 0), 0)::int AS moved_in_count,
  GREATEST(COALESCE(prev_stage_count, 0) - stage_count, 0)::int AS moved_out_count,
  won_count,
  lost_count,
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'rollups', 'workflow_name', '${workflowName}', 'mode', 'ghl_backfill_90d')::jsonb,
  NOW()
FROM stage_with_prev;

DELETE FROM report_utm_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};
INSERT INTO report_utm_daily_summary (
  report_date, source, medium, campaign, content, term, landing_page, sessions, leads, opportunities, closed_won_revenue, metadata, updated_at
)
SELECT
  d.report_date,
  c.source,
  c.medium,
  c.campaign,
  c.content,
  c.term,
  c.landing_page,
  0 AS sessions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.ghl_contact_id) AS leads,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.ghl_opportunity_id) AS opportunities,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(o.status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won') THEN o.monetary_value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closed_won_revenue,
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'rollups', 'workflow_name', '${workflowName}', 'mode', 'ghl_backfill_90d')::jsonb,
  NOW()
FROM tmp_report_dates d
JOIN tmp_report_contacts c ON c.report_date = d.report_date
LEFT JOIN tmp_report_opps o ON o.report_date = d.report_date AND o.ghl_contact_id = c.ghl_contact_id
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7;

DELETE FROM report_landing_page_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};
INSERT INTO report_landing_page_daily_summary (
  report_date, landing_page, sessions, engaged_sessions, leads, opportunities, form_submissions, closed_won_revenue, metadata, updated_at
)
SELECT
  d.report_date,
  c.landing_page,
  0,
  0,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.ghl_contact_id) AS leads,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.ghl_opportunity_id) AS opportunities,
  0 AS form_submissions,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(o.status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won') THEN o.monetary_value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closed_won_revenue,
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'rollups', 'workflow_name', '${workflowName}', 'mode', 'ghl_backfill_90d')::jsonb,
  NOW()
FROM tmp_report_dates d
JOIN tmp_report_contacts c ON c.report_date = d.report_date
LEFT JOIN tmp_report_opps o ON o.report_date = d.report_date AND o.ghl_contact_id = c.ghl_contact_id
GROUP BY 1, 2;
`;

return [{
  json: {
    workflowName,
    sourceSystem,
    daysBack,
    batchId: `backfill-${Date.now()}`,
    sql,
  },
}];

const s = $node['Summarize Run'].json;
const q = (value) => `'${String(value).replace(/'/g, "''")}'`;
const jsonQ = (value) => q(JSON.stringify(value));

const runSql = `INSERT INTO report_sync_runs (
  workflow_name, source_system, report_date, batch_id, status, started_at, finished_at, row_count, error_count, retry_count, cursor_value, error_message, metadata
) VALUES (
  ${q('LT - Report Daily Rollups')},
  ${q('rollups')},
  CURRENT_DATE,
  ${q(s.batchId)},
  'completed',
  NOW(),
  NOW(),
  ${Number(s.executedStatements || 0)},
  0,
  0,
  CURRENT_DATE::text,
  NULL,
  ${jsonQ({ executedStatements: s.executedStatements || 0, note: 'GHL-only rollups scaffold is live.' })}::jsonb
);`;
const watermarkSql = `INSERT INTO report_sync_watermarks (
  workflow_name, source_system, watermark_key, watermark_value, updated_at
) VALUES (
  ${q('LT - Report Daily Rollups')},
  ${q('rollups')},
  'latest_report_date',
  CURRENT_DATE::text,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (workflow_name, source_system, watermark_key) DO UPDATE SET
  watermark_value = EXCLUDED.watermark_value,
  updated_at = NOW();`;
const healthSql = `INSERT INTO report_source_health (
  source_system, status, last_success_at, last_attempt_at, last_row_count, stale_after_hours, last_error, metadata, updated_at
) VALUES (
  ${q('rollups')},
  'ready',
  NOW(),
  NOW(),
  ${Number(s.executedStatements || 0)},
  48,
  NULL,
  ${jsonQ({ workflowName: s.workflowName, executedStatements: s.executedStatements || 0 })}::jsonb,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (source_system) DO UPDATE SET
  status = EXCLUDED.status,
  last_success_at = EXCLUDED.last_success_at,
  last_attempt_at = EXCLUDED.last_attempt_at,
  last_row_count = EXCLUDED.last_row_count,
  last_error = EXCLUDED.last_error,
  metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata,
  updated_at = NOW();`;
return [{json:{sql:runSql}},{json:{sql:watermarkSql}},{json:{sql:healthSql}}];

const s = $node['Summarize Run'].json;
return [{json:{ok:true,workflow:s.workflowName,status:'prepared',source:s.sourceSystem,reportDate:s.reportDate,executedStatements:s.executedStatements,note:'GHL-only daily rollups are live and will be expanded when GA4 and GSC are unlocked.'}}];

Purpose

- Summarize traffic, leads, sales, and attribution by dimension.

Status
- Live starter chain.
- GHL-only interim rollups are ready now; GA4/GSC metrics will fill in when those feeds are unlocked.

parameters.jsCode:
const daysBack = 90;
const windowStart = "CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '89 days'";
const windowEnd = "CURRENT_DATE";
const workflowName = 'LT - Report Daily Rollups';
const sourceSystem = 'rollups';

const sql = `
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_report_contacts;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_report_opps;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_report_forms;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_report_dates;

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_report_contacts AS
SELECT
  DATE(COALESCE(
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz,
    NULLIF(payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz,
    NULLIF(payload_json->>'dateAdded', '')::timestamptz,
    NOW()
  )) AS report_date,
  source_key AS ghl_contact_id,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_source_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_source_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Source First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Source Last', ''), 'unknown') AS source,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_medium_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_medium_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Medium First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Medium Last', ''), 'unknown') AS medium,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_campaign_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_campaign_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Campaign First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Campaign Last', ''), 'unknown') AS campaign,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_content_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_content_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Content First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Content Last', ''), 'unknown') AS content,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_term_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_term_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Term First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Term Last', ''), 'unknown') AS term,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_landing_page_first', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_landing_page_last', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Landing Page First', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'UTM Landing Page Last', ''), 'unknown') AS landing_page,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.lt_last_routing_channel', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.warm_source', ''), CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(dimensions_json->>'contact.utm_source_first', dimensions_json->>'UTM Source First', '')) IN ('google', 'bing', 'yahoo') THEN 'organic search' ELSE 'unattributed' END, 'unattributed') AS channel,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.lt_last_routing_reason', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.warm_trigger_type', ''), 'ghl_source') AS routing_reason,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(payload_json->>'email', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'Email', '')) AS email,
  payload_json
FROM report_raw_ghl_contacts
WHERE DATE(COALESCE(
  NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz,
  NULLIF(payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz,
  NULLIF(payload_json->>'dateAdded', '')::timestamptz,
  NOW()
)) BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_report_opps AS
SELECT
  DATE(COALESCE(
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz,
    NULLIF(payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz,
    NULLIF(payload_json->>'lastStatusChangeAt', '')::timestamptz,
    NOW()
  )) AS report_date,
  source_key AS ghl_opportunity_id,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact_id', ''), NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'contact.id', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'contactId', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'contact_id', '')) AS ghl_contact_id,
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'pipeline_name', ''),
    NULLIF(payload_json->>'pipelineName', ''),
    CASE COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'pipeline_id', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'pipelineId', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->'pipeline'->>'id', ''))
      WHEN 'FRjpDZ1HWj3UPgczsu3t' THEN 'Warm'
      WHEN 'dhdlf3O4tymxFtHk4aqq' THEN 'Sales Outreach'
      WHEN 'MThKauqlvnEFuFmAkyWX' THEN 'Sales'
      ELSE NULL
    END,
    'unknown'
  ) AS pipeline,
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'pipeline_stage_name', ''),
    NULLIF(payload_json->>'pipelineStageName', ''),
    NULLIF(payload_json->>'stage', ''),
    CASE COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'pipeline_stage_id', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'pipelineStageId', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->'pipelineStage'->>'id', ''))
      WHEN 'b961de1f-34fd-4b66-b032-f21225654868' THEN 'New'
      WHEN '3b3bd98d-cbb9-4c50-8cf3-b4eba29061c2' THEN 'Qualified (MQL)'
      WHEN '477c0b59-4a64-4566-81d6-63e233362520' THEN 'Routed to Outreach'
      WHEN '98775f02-0018-4629-9e69-0b1fcab293eb' THEN 'Nurture Active'
      WHEN 'dae2ddc5-a031-4ffa-bcdb-79d5c9afe91b' THEN 'Disqualified'
      WHEN '3529dd3d-cab0-4279-967c-1aea203de4fb' THEN 'New'
      WHEN 'b97e42b1-b4c2-4759-8212-33596a085cf2' THEN 'Attempting Contact 1st Attempt'
      WHEN 'c46c3be3-a216-4489-8ae3-c4284cfc747f' THEN '2nd attempt'
      WHEN 'c8b7a450-462a-497d-ab86-65f9a8e9b082' THEN '3rd attempt'
      WHEN '9ced8010-dfd7-4d5b-aa9c-c2eb58fca94d' THEN 'Engaged'
      WHEN '1ab47457-c945-4d16-9dd7-305583823114' THEN 'Meeting Requested'
      WHEN '1f95dd0a-1cf2-4d31-abad-825d97d3ef69' THEN 'Booked'
      WHEN '23276991-fbb3-4b0f-8d65-35c737b62bdd' THEN 'Unresponsive'
      WHEN '6f5aa304-a190-40da-8556-7c65bbc52733' THEN 'Discovery Scheduled'
      WHEN 'facd3d31-c634-40c5-9271-17d608b4379c' THEN 'Discovery Completed'
      WHEN '42b12e59-9b51-4c82-b597-4a9c972322c9' THEN 'Proposal Sent'
      WHEN 'f9022c83-7791-45c9-903d-381668454b2f' THEN 'Negotiation'
      WHEN 'f6b65baa-eac8-4f02-b91e-2ab0c8841b2d' THEN 'Closed Won'
      WHEN 'd7784617-96f4-4ae4-8b3e-e2088b62627d' THEN 'Closed Lost'
      ELSE NULL
    END,
    'unknown'
  ) AS stage,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'status', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'status', ''), 'open') AS status,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(metrics_json->>'monetary_value', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'monetaryValue', ''), NULLIF(payload_json->>'amount', ''), '0')::numeric AS monetary_value,
  payload_json
FROM report_raw_ghl_opportunities
WHERE DATE(COALESCE(
  NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz,
  NULLIF(payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz,
  NULLIF(payload_json->>'lastStatusChangeAt', '')::timestamptz,
  NOW()
)) BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_report_forms AS
SELECT
  DATE(COALESCE(
    NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz,
    NULLIF(payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz,
    NOW()
  )) AS report_date,
  source_key AS form_key,
  payload_json
FROM report_raw_ghl_forms
WHERE DATE(COALESCE(
  NULLIF(dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz,
  NULLIF(payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz,
  NOW()
)) BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_bridge_traffic AS
SELECT DISTINCT ON (report_date, ghl_contact_id)
  report_date,
  ghl_contact_id,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(source_trace->>'channel', ''),
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(traffic_source, '')) IN ('google', 'bing', 'yahoo') AND LOWER(COALESCE(medium, '')) IN ('organic', '(not set)', 'unknown', '') THEN 'organic search'
      WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(medium, '')) LIKE '%email%' THEN 'email'
      WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(medium, '')) LIKE '%sms%' THEN 'sms'
      ELSE 'unattributed'
    END
  ) AS channel,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(traffic_source, ''), 'unknown') AS source,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(medium, ''), 'unknown') AS medium,
  updated_at
FROM report_bridge_traffic_to_lead
WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd}
  AND COALESCE(ghl_contact_id, '') <> ''
ORDER BY report_date, ghl_contact_id, updated_at DESC;

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_report_dates AS
SELECT DISTINCT report_date FROM tmp_report_contacts
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT report_date FROM tmp_report_opps
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT report_date FROM tmp_report_forms;

DELETE FROM report_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};
INSERT INTO report_daily_summary (
  report_date, sessions, users, new_users, engaged_sessions, engagement_rate, gsc_clicks, gsc_impressions, gsc_ctr, gsc_position, contacts_created, form_submissions, opportunities_created, meetings_booked, closed_won_count, closed_won_revenue, closed_lost_count, metadata, updated_at
)
SELECT
  d.report_date,
  0,
  0,
  0,
  0,
  0,
  0,
  0,
  0,
  0,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_contacts c WHERE c.report_date = d.report_date), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_forms f WHERE f.report_date = d.report_date), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_opps o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_opps o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date AND (LOWER(stage) LIKE '%booked%' OR LOWER(stage) LIKE '%discovery scheduled%' OR LOWER(stage) LIKE '%meeting scheduled%')), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_opps o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date AND LOWER(status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won')), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(monetary_value) FROM tmp_report_opps o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date AND LOWER(status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won')), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_opps o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date AND LOWER(status) IN ('lost', 'closed_lost', 'closed lost')), 0),
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'rollups', 'workflow_name', '${workflowName}', 'mode', 'ghl_backfill_90d')::jsonb,
  NOW()
FROM tmp_report_dates d;

DELETE FROM report_channel_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};
INSERT INTO report_channel_daily_summary (
  report_date, channel, traffic_source, source, medium, sessions, users, new_users, leads, opportunities, closed_won_revenue, metadata, updated_at
)
WITH lead_facts AS (
  SELECT
    c.report_date,
    COALESCE(bt.channel, c.channel, 'unattributed') AS channel,
    COALESCE(bt.source, c.source, 'unknown') AS source,
    COALESCE(bt.medium, c.medium, 'unknown') AS medium,
    c.ghl_contact_id
  FROM tmp_report_contacts c
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT b.channel, b.source, b.medium
    FROM tmp_bridge_traffic b
    WHERE b.ghl_contact_id = c.ghl_contact_id
      AND b.report_date <= c.report_date
    ORDER BY b.report_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) bt ON TRUE
),
opp_facts AS (
  SELECT
    o.report_date,
    COALESCE(bt.channel, c.channel, 'unattributed') AS channel,
    COALESCE(bt.source, c.source, 'unknown') AS source,
    COALESCE(bt.medium, c.medium, 'unknown') AS medium,
    o.ghl_opportunity_id,
    o.status,
    o.monetary_value
  FROM tmp_report_opps o
  LEFT JOIN tmp_report_contacts c ON c.ghl_contact_id = o.ghl_contact_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT b.channel, b.source, b.medium
    FROM tmp_bridge_traffic b
    WHERE b.ghl_contact_id = o.ghl_contact_id
      AND b.report_date <= o.report_date
    ORDER BY b.report_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) bt ON TRUE
),
combined AS (
  SELECT report_date, channel, source, medium, COUNT(DISTINCT ghl_contact_id) AS leads, 0::bigint AS opportunities, 0::numeric AS closed_won_revenue
  FROM lead_facts
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
  UNION ALL
  SELECT report_date, channel, source, medium, 0::bigint AS leads, COUNT(DISTINCT ghl_opportunity_id) AS opportunities,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won') THEN monetary_value ELSE 0 END), 0)::numeric AS closed_won_revenue
  FROM opp_facts
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
)
SELECT
  d.report_date,
  c.channel,
  c.source,
  c.source,
  c.medium,
  0,
  0,
  0,
  SUM(c.leads)::bigint AS leads,
  SUM(c.opportunities)::bigint AS opportunities,
  SUM(c.closed_won_revenue)::numeric AS closed_won_revenue,
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'rollups', 'workflow_name', '${workflowName}', 'mode', 'ghl_backfill_90d')::jsonb,
  NOW()
FROM tmp_report_dates d
JOIN combined c ON c.report_date = d.report_date
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5;

DELETE FROM report_funnel_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};
INSERT INTO report_funnel_daily_summary (
  report_date, traffic, leads, sales, contact_to_opportunity_rate, opportunity_to_win_rate, metadata, updated_at
)
SELECT
  d.report_date,
  0,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_contacts c WHERE c.report_date = d.report_date), 0),
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_opps o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date AND LOWER(status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won')), 0),
  CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_contacts c WHERE c.report_date = d.report_date), 0) > 0
    THEN ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_opps o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date), 0)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_contacts c WHERE c.report_date = d.report_date), 0), 4)
    ELSE 0
  END,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_opps o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date), 0) > 0
    THEN ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_opps o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date AND LOWER(status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won')), 0)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_report_opps o WHERE o.report_date = d.report_date), 0), 4)
    ELSE 0
  END,
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'rollups', 'workflow_name', '${workflowName}', 'mode', 'ghl_backfill_90d')::jsonb,
  NOW()
FROM tmp_report_dates d;

DELETE FROM report_pipeline_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};
INSERT INTO report_pipeline_daily_summary (
  report_date, pipeline, leads, opportunities, booked, closed_won_count, closed_won_revenue, closed_lost_count, metadata, updated_at
)
SELECT
  report_date,
  pipeline,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ghl_contact_id) AS leads,
  COUNT(*) AS opportunities,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(stage) LIKE '%booked%' OR LOWER(stage) LIKE '%discovery scheduled%' OR LOWER(stage) LIKE '%meeting scheduled%') AS booked,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won')) AS closed_won_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won') THEN monetary_value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closed_won_revenue,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(status) IN ('lost', 'closed_lost', 'closed lost')) AS closed_lost_count,
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'rollups', 'workflow_name', '${workflowName}', 'mode', 'ghl_backfill_90d')::jsonb,
  NOW()
FROM tmp_report_opps
GROUP BY 1, 2;

DELETE FROM report_stage_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};
INSERT INTO report_stage_daily_summary (
  report_date, pipeline, stage, stage_count, moved_in_count, moved_out_count, won_count, lost_count, metadata, updated_at
)
WITH stage_counts AS (
  SELECT
    report_date,
    pipeline,
    stage,
    COUNT(*)::int AS stage_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won'))::int AS won_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(status) IN ('lost', 'closed_lost', 'closed lost'))::int AS lost_count
  FROM tmp_report_opps
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
stage_with_prev AS (
  SELECT
    report_date,
    pipeline,
    stage,
    stage_count,
    LAG(stage_count) OVER (PARTITION BY pipeline, stage ORDER BY report_date) AS prev_stage_count,
    won_count,
    lost_count
  FROM stage_counts
)
SELECT
  report_date,
  pipeline,
  stage,
  stage_count,
  GREATEST(stage_count - COALESCE(prev_stage_count, 0), 0)::int AS moved_in_count,
  GREATEST(COALESCE(prev_stage_count, 0) - stage_count, 0)::int AS moved_out_count,
  won_count,
  lost_count,
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'rollups', 'workflow_name', '${workflowName}', 'mode', 'ghl_backfill_90d')::jsonb,
  NOW()
FROM stage_with_prev;

DELETE FROM report_utm_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};
INSERT INTO report_utm_daily_summary (
  report_date, source, medium, campaign, content, term, landing_page, sessions, leads, opportunities, closed_won_revenue, metadata, updated_at
)
SELECT
  d.report_date,
  c.source,
  c.medium,
  c.campaign,
  c.content,
  c.term,
  c.landing_page,
  0 AS sessions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.ghl_contact_id) AS leads,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.ghl_opportunity_id) AS opportunities,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(o.status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won') THEN o.monetary_value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closed_won_revenue,
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'rollups', 'workflow_name', '${workflowName}', 'mode', 'ghl_backfill_90d')::jsonb,
  NOW()
FROM tmp_report_dates d
JOIN tmp_report_contacts c ON c.report_date = d.report_date
LEFT JOIN tmp_report_opps o ON o.report_date = d.report_date AND o.ghl_contact_id = c.ghl_contact_id
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7;

DELETE FROM report_landing_page_daily_summary WHERE report_date BETWEEN ${windowStart} AND ${windowEnd};
INSERT INTO report_landing_page_daily_summary (
  report_date, landing_page, sessions, engaged_sessions, leads, opportunities, form_submissions, closed_won_revenue, metadata, updated_at
)
SELECT
  d.report_date,
  c.landing_page,
  0,
  0,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.ghl_contact_id) AS leads,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.ghl_opportunity_id) AS opportunities,
  0 AS form_submissions,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(o.status) IN ('won', 'closed_won', 'closed won') THEN o.monetary_value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closed_won_revenue,
  jsonb_build_object('source_system', 'rollups', 'workflow_name', '${workflowName}', 'mode', 'ghl_backfill_90d')::jsonb,
  NOW()
FROM tmp_report_dates d
JOIN tmp_report_contacts c ON c.report_date = d.report_date
LEFT JOIN tmp_report_opps o ON o.report_date = d.report_date AND o.ghl_contact_id = c.ghl_contact_id
GROUP BY 1, 2;
`;

return [{
  json: {
    workflowName,
    sourceSystem,
    daysBack,
    batchId: `backfill-${Date.now()}`,
    sql,
  },
}];

const s = $node['Summarize Run'].json;
const q = (value) => `'${String(value).replace(/'/g, "''")}'`;
const jsonQ = (value) => q(JSON.stringify(value));

const runSql = `INSERT INTO report_sync_runs (
  workflow_name, source_system, report_date, batch_id, status, started_at, finished_at, row_count, error_count, retry_count, cursor_value, error_message, metadata
) VALUES (
  ${q('LT - Report Daily Rollups')},
  ${q('rollups')},
  CURRENT_DATE,
  ${q(s.batchId)},
  'completed',
  NOW(),
  NOW(),
  ${Number(s.executedStatements || 0)},
  0,
  0,
  CURRENT_DATE::text,
  NULL,
  ${jsonQ({ executedStatements: s.executedStatements || 0, note: 'GHL-only rollups scaffold is live.' })}::jsonb
);`;
const watermarkSql = `INSERT INTO report_sync_watermarks (
  workflow_name, source_system, watermark_key, watermark_value, updated_at
) VALUES (
  ${q('LT - Report Daily Rollups')},
  ${q('rollups')},
  'latest_report_date',
  CURRENT_DATE::text,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (workflow_name, source_system, watermark_key) DO UPDATE SET
  watermark_value = EXCLUDED.watermark_value,
  updated_at = NOW();`;
const healthSql = `INSERT INTO report_source_health (
  source_system, status, last_success_at, last_attempt_at, last_row_count, stale_after_hours, last_error, metadata, updated_at
) VALUES (
  ${q('rollups')},
  'ready',
  NOW(),
  NOW(),
  ${Number(s.executedStatements || 0)},
  48,
  NULL,
  ${jsonQ({ workflowName: s.workflowName, executedStatements: s.executedStatements || 0 })}::jsonb,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (source_system) DO UPDATE SET
  status = EXCLUDED.status,
  last_success_at = EXCLUDED.last_success_at,
  last_attempt_at = EXCLUDED.last_attempt_at,
  last_row_count = EXCLUDED.last_row_count,
  last_error = EXCLUDED.last_error,
  metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata,
  updated_at = NOW();`;
return [{json:{sql:runSql}},{json:{sql:watermarkSql}},{json:{sql:healthSql}}];

const s = $node['Summarize Run'].json;
return [{json:{ok:true,workflow:s.workflowName,status:'prepared',source:s.sourceSystem,reportDate:s.reportDate,executedStatements:s.executedStatements,note:'GHL-only daily rollups are live and will be expanded when GA4 and GSC are unlocked.'}}];

LT - Report Daily Rollups

Purpose
- Aggregate daily KPI tables for the embedded report.
- Summarize traffic, leads, sales, and attribution by dimension.

Status
- Live starter chain.
- GHL-only interim rollups are ready now; GA4/GSC metrics will fill in when those feeds are unlocked.
